summary: @benwerd when I show my family what Known looks like now with the website pinned to my phone that is almost exactly what they would want. If we had mcverry.com registered as a social reader where signed in users could interact with content (while publishing to their own site) I could almost convince them to stop our forever group SMS messages.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @benwerd when I show my family what Known looks like now with the website pinned to my phone that is almost exactly what they would want. If we had mcverry.com registered as a social reader where signed in users could interact with content (while publishing to their own site) I could almost convince them to stop our forever group SMS messages.
